title: [Master Data Management] Cross-env over-cap blob clears the subsidiary blob
summary: In cross-environment Master Data Management sync, a source blob over 512 KB is no longer sent inline, and now a skip marker keeps the existing destination blob instead of clearing it. The inline media cache now uses last-write-wins per record and field, so the newest media state is applied.
key_points: Source blobs over 512 KB are not sent inline, which previously cleared the destination blob
A skip marker carried from materialization to transfer keeps the destination blob unchanged
Inline media cache is last-write-wins per (SystemId, field) for records arriving on several pages in one batch
Regression tests added for both cases
quote: Carry a skip marker from materialization to transfer time and keep the destination blob unchanged.
